h1: Custom Metal Buttons for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom metal buttons in bulk for events, promotions, or branding. Fast turnaround and free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Metal buttons offer a polished, durable alternative to standard plastic pins. They resist scratching and fading, making them ideal for trade shows, retail tags, or premium giveaways. With a smooth finish and secure pin back, these buttons hold up to daily use while keeping your logo or message looking sharp. Choose from single-button cards or multi-panel collage layouts for more design space.
heroAltText: Custom metal buttons with smooth finish and pin back, ideal for branding and promotions
